guideBlocks.title: Archive contents
guideBlocks.text: The archive contains patch_mp.ff and READ ME FIRST.txt. The readme identifies xClickyModz and the patch credits but does not give a file destination, game update or region. Confirm those requirements before replacing game files and preserve originals.

discord-ps3-mw2-snow-engine.region: CEX folders: BLES00683 and BLUS30377; DEX EBOOT has no region folder label.
discord-ps3-mw2-snow-engine.compatibility: Archive contains CEX and DEX EBOOT variants plus SnowMW2.sprx. Exact game update and firmware are not specified.

guideBlocks.title: Choose the labelled archive variant
guideBlocks.text: Static inspection found CEX/BLES00683/EBOOT.BIN, CEX/BLUS30377/EBOOT.BIN, DEX/EBOOT.BIN and SnowMW2.sprx. These are archive labels, not hardware test results. Match your console environment and title ID, preserve the original EBOOT and confirm the loader and destination before copying files.

guideBlocks.title: Archive readme
guideBlocks.text: The readme places NightFire.sprx in /dev_hdd0/tmp/ and EBOOT.BIN in the matching World at War USRDIR. Preserve the original EBOOT first. Host: L1 + R3 opens, X selects, L1/R1 scroll and Square returns. Non-host: D-pad Left opens, Square selects, L2/R2 scroll and Circle returns.

discord-ps3-waw-external-3.compatibility: Separate CFW and HEN folders, labelled World at War 1.07. Exact firmware and region are not specified.

guideBlocks.title: Archive readme
guideBlocks.text: Choose the matching CFW or HEN folder. Preserve the original EBOOT.BIN. Place ParadiseWAW.sprx in /dev_hdd0/tmp/ and the selected EBOOT.BIN in the correct regional game USRDIR. The distributor deliberately renamed External.sprx to ParadiseWAW.sprx to match the supplied EBOOT; keep the supplied filename.

discord-ps3-waw-paradise.compatibility: Contains CFW 1.3 and HEN folders. Exact firmware, region and game update are not specified.

guideBlocks.title: Archive controls file
guideBlocks.text: The CFW controls file gives D-pad Up + L1 to open or close, X to select, Up/Down to scroll in game and R1/L1 to scroll in the pregame menu. The archive supplies separate CFW and HEN EBOOT/SPRX files; choose the matching pair and preserve original game files.

guideBlocks.title: Choose the PS3 release asset
guideBlocks.text: The pinned V2 release labels update.rpf for PS3 CFW/HEN. Its Boxuga.V2.Xbox.zip is a separate Xbox 360 RGH build. Keep these platforms separate and preserve your original game files.

guideBlocks.title: Optional loader scripts
guideBlocks.text: Scripts.zip contains BoxugaLoader.csc and PS3 CTD textures alongside separate Xbox XSC/XTD files. The author describes this archive as scripts for loading through another loader. Read.txt gives a stack size of 2024 and L1/LB + Left as the controls. Keep the platform-specific texture assets with the matching script.

guideBlocks.title: Requirements still unspecified
guideBlocks.text: The captured post and V2 release do not supply a PS3 title ID, game update or exact installation destination. Confirm those requirements against your game before replacing update.rpf. The README describes GTA V Story Mode controls; it does not establish compatibility with every online service.
